## Auto Rename Tag (Linked Editing)
 - Type inside a tag name and the matching closing or opening tag is renamed with you
 - Works on HTML, XHTML, SVG, XML, and template files (.vue, .svelte, .astro, .hbs, .twig, .jsp, .php, .cshtml, ...)
 - Same behaviour as VS Code's Auto Rename Tag / `editor.linkedEditing`
 - Aware of HTML structure: comments, CDATA, doctypes, `script`/`style`/`textarea` bodies, void elements and self-closing tags are never touched
 - Nested tags of the same name pair with the correct level, tag matching is case-insensitive like HTML
 - Every rename goes through the editor undo history
 - Settings screen lets you switch the file scope between HTML, HTML + XML, and templates
